metadata.title: LeGuide — Student Admin Guide
metadata.description: A step-by-step survival guide that helps international students navigate life and bureaucracy in France.

landing.badge: 🇫🇷 Built for international students in France
landing.heroSubtitle: Visa validation, CAF housing aid, healthcare, banking, transport — every step explained, tracked, and simplified in one place.
